rubric_items.reason: All 15 known REQs are traced; REQ-11 covers the list, appointment page and patient page, the only places an appointment status shows (AppointmentTable and AppointmentDetailPage).
Stories mostly carry one outcome; S-5 still bundles label, filter and the dashboard constraint but stays small.

S-1/S-2/S-4 bracket 24h at 09:59/10:01 and S-4 AC2 catches measuring from the original start; previous F-1 fixed. S-7 AC2 leaves the Scheduled appointment's start time open, which the doctor query needs.
24h comes from REQ-2/A-02; the one-minute offsets are derived inline; dates are example data, not limits.
Consistent terms with glossary and intent; S-6 now has a user-facing title (previous F-2 resolved).

findings.text: S-7 AC2 does not say the doctor's Scheduled appointment is upcoming. The doctor page lists only Scheduled appointments with starts_at >= now, so a past Scheduled one would not be listed and the AC could fail against a correct build.

cites.quote: Given a Stale appointment and a Scheduled appointment of the same doctor, when staff open that doctor's page

findings.suggested_fix: Give the Scheduled appointment a future start time, for example 'a Scheduled appointment starting at 10:00 on 6 December, opened on 4 December'.

cites.quote: has not been marked Completed or `rescheduled` by 24h after its start time is marked Stale
upcoming first (soonest first), then past (most recent first)
